MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Ember Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla
• Maximum spatial field gradient of 1,900 gauss/cm (19 T/m)
• Gradient slew rate ≤ 200 T/m/s (per axis)
• Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.2-W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• Limit scanning to one hour of continuous active scan time
• Followed by a wait time of 5 minutes
• Any receive-only coil may be used
• Device configuration: Stimulation OFF
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Ember Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.1 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
In non-clinical testing, the image artifact caused by the device extends approximately 40 mm from the device when imaged with a gradient echo pulse sequence and a 3-Tesla MR system.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
